properties.name: Regnum Gothorum
properties.linkNote: The Codex has no article for the Visigothic Kingdom itself, only for the Visigoths as a people. This links to the people; the state remains a gap.

properties.name: Imperium Romanum Orientale
properties.linkNote: The source names it as contemporaries did — the Eastern Roman Empire. 'Byzantine' is a later historians' label for the same state.
